sloka: सीताम् पद्म पलाश अक्षीम् मन्मथस्य रतिम् यथा ।इष्टाम् सर्वस्य जगतः पूर्ण चन्द्र प्रभाम् इव ॥५-१५-३०॥
transliteration: sītām padma palāśa akṣīm manmathasya ratim yathā ।iṣṭām sarvasya jagataḥ pūrṇa candra prabhām iva ॥5-15-30॥

translations.english: Just as the radiance of the full moon is cherished by all, this lady was liked by every one in this world. With her lovely figure she was seated on the ground like an austere ascetic.
